family: E_t/Q: y^2=x^3+t*x+1 with Q=(0,1), integer t from 1 through 64; reduce at each fixed prime p
selection_rule: for each p, test t ascending from 1 through 64; select first two with nonzero discriminant modulo p, prime #E_t(F_p)=q, and reduced Q of order q; retain every eligibility decision; do not inspect lift or rho outcomes during selection
seed_rule: for j=0,1,2 choose k=1+int(SHA256(UTF8(seed+':'+p+':'+t+':'+j)).hexdigest(),16) mod (q-1), require distinct and outside controls; construct T=k*Qbar outside timing; pass only public coordinates to lift search
lift_law: x=a/b^2,y=c/b^3; increasing H=max(abs(a),b) from 1 to 4096, then b and a; b>=1, gcd(abs(a),b)=1, b not divisible by p; modular x filter, exact integral discriminant for c^2=a^3+t*a*b^4+b^6, both c signs; first point reducing to the supplied public (x,y)
arm_order: for even zero-based target index lift then rho, for odd index rho then lift
measurement_boundary: ordinary-host diagnostic; lift online interval is target-dependent point search through verification or cap, rho online interval is same-public-point scalar walk through verification; setup and target fixture construction excluded; stage and full-solve outputs remain distinct
claim_boundary: finite selected four-curve family panel; empirical bounded-height statuses and same-point rho references, no general curve-family impossibility theorem
